statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of seven paths/templates. Not covered: posting/login/account flows (not exposed by public WebBBS), age-gated boards, exhaustive board categories, and external legal/Facebook destinations.

page.framework: Server-rendered HTML with legacy jQuery on WebBBS pages
page.notes: PTT combines a legacy informational template with a newer dark WebBBS template. Public browsing and search are server-rendered.

paths.description: Public service homepage and legacy informational template; tested desktop, 360px mobile, dark preference, and no-JS crawler view.
WebBBS hot-board directory, representing the primary content-discovery entry point.
Stock board listing, representing board navigation, pagination, search, menus, and repeated interaction.
Representative article/detail page with comments and user images.
Primary search journey from a board to populated results.
Contact/help informational template and route off the global navigation.
Recovery behavior for an invalid URL.

findings.summary: Theme is fixed rather than preference-aware
findings.evidence: Dark-emulation screenshots show the legacy homepage remains light while the BBS remains hard-coded dark; the DOM probe reports colorScheme "normal" and no preference-driven theme CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme/light-dark() tokens across both templates.

findings.summary: Navigation and state changes swap abruptly
findings.evidence: CSS/DOM probes found no view-transition rules; board navigation and menu state changes use immediate legacy behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive same-document and cross-document View Transitions, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Article menus are ad-hoc div overlays
findings.evidence: Board DOM uses .trigger and .dropdown divs rather than buttons/popover, and contains no anchor positioning, dialog, popover, or details primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a named button with popover and CSS anchor positioning/position-try fallbacks.

findings.summary: Legacy pages render as a scaled desktop canvas on phones
findings.evidence: At a requested 360px viewport the homepage layout reports a 980px layout viewport because it lacks a viewport meta tag; the screenshot shows tiny, unreadable text and controls. Contact uses the same template.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a standards viewport meta tag and rebuild the legacy template with fluid/intrinsic layout and readable mobile typography.

findings.summary: Reusable listing UI has no component-level adaptation
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no @container rules; adaptation is limited to global layout behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries where board/listing components are reused at different widths.

findings.summary: Search and article-list controls are not robustly input-modality aware
findings.evidence: The search input has no accessible label and no visible focused outline; many article links measure only 17px high, well below comfortable touch target guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a real label, strong :focus-visible styles, and enlarge clickable rows/targets to at least 24px, preferably 44px.

findings.summary: Error routes provide no recovery
findings.evidence: The tested invalid URL returns a bare nginx 404 with no explanation, search, retry, or link back to PTT.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404 with useful context, search, and routes back to boards/home.

findings.summary: Render-blocking dependencies delay content
findings.evidence: Lighthouse mobile measured LCP 4.3s/FCP 3.4s and estimated 1.91s savings from render-blocking CSS, font CSS, jQuery 2.1.1, and bbs.js; trace corroborated ~2.07s LCP with zero long tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline minimal critical CSS, defer noncritical styles/scripts, self-host or optimize fonts, and remove jQuery from the initial critical path.

findings.summary: User images lack dimensions
findings.evidence: The image primitive found all 3 article images without width/height; Lighthouse reported CLS 0.052 and failed the unsized-images audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image space with width/height or aspect-ratio before lazy images load.

findings.summary: Analytics code dominates shipped JavaScript
findings.evidence: HAR shows 241KB of script and Lighthouse estimates 74KiB unused JavaScript, largely gtag; the page also loads both GA4 and legacy Universal Analytics initializers.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate/legacy analytics, conditionally load analytics after consent or idle, and avoid shipping unused tag-manager code.

findings.summary: Content images and search lack accessible names
findings.evidence: The image audit found all 3 article images with empty/missing alt; the board search input has placeholder text but no label or aria-label.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate meaningful alt text where images convey content and add a persistent programmatic label to search.

findings.summary: Inline links rely on color alone
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility found article links with only 1.21:1 contrast against surrounding text and no underline/non-color distinction.
findings.suggestedFix: Underline inline links or add another persistent cue and meet the 3:1 adjacent-text distinction.

findings.summary: Pages lack semantic structure and consistent focus indication
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no main landmark and no html lang; the board probe found no headings/landmarks, while the focused search input has outline none.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main/nav/header landmarks and logical headings, set lang, and provide visible :focus-visible styling.

findings.summary: A missing favicon logs a console error
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded a 404 console/network error for https://www.ptt.cc/favicon.ico.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid favicon or reference an existing icon.

findings.summary: The runtime ships an obsolete jQuery build
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM loads jQuery 2.1.1 synchronously; this legacy dependency is over a decade old and is not needed for the mostly server-rendered page.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the small interactions with modern DOM APIs or upgrade after compatibility/security review.

findings.summary: Key public templates omit meta descriptions
findings.evidence: Homepage and board-listing DOM provide titles but no meta description; only the article template includes one.
findings.suggestedFix: Add unique, useful descriptions to homepage, directory, board, search, and contact templates.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are incomplete
findings.evidence: robots.txt and sitemap.xml both returned 404; board/home templates omit canonical links, and the homepage also omits viewport metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish robots.txt and sitemap.xml, add canonical URLs per public template, and keep indexing policy consistent.

findings.summary: Article metadata lacks structured data
findings.evidence: The article includes title, description, canonical and Open Graph metadata but no JSON-LD describing article/discussion content.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org DiscussionForumPosting or Article JSON-LD matching visible content.

findings.summary: Browser security headers and cookie flags are absent
findings.evidence: Header audit found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. All 4 analytics cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None; two last 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; mark cookies Secure and use the narrowest SameSite/lifetime.

findings.summary: Tracking begins immediately with a broad third-party footprint
findings.evidence: Tracker audit observed 10 third-party origins and Google Analytics, Tag Manager and DoubleClick; HAR attributes 461,729 of 467,877 transferred bytes to non-www.ptt.cc origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize analytics, avoid advertising audience calls where unnecessary, load only after an appropriate consent/context decision, and proxy/self-host essential assets.

findings.summary: The WebBBS has no install or offline fallback
findings.evidence: DOM/platform probes found no web app manifest; an invalid/network-like route falls through to a bare server error and no offline experience was exposed.
findings.suggestedFix: For this app-like board reader, add a manifest and service worker with a small offline/retry fallback for previously visited content.

findings.summary: Language and time output are not internationalisation-ready
findings.evidence: Across audited pages html.lang and dir are empty; article timestamps are fixed English strings such as "Fri Jul 24 10:27:18 2026" on Chinese content, with no locale/time-zone context.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang="zh-Hant-TW" (and dir as appropriate), use logical properties, and render dates via Intl with an explicit time zone and machine-readable datetime.

findings.summary: Article images are not delivered responsively
findings.evidence: All 3 images are JPEG with no dimensions; 2 lack srcset. Lighthouse estimates 113KiB image savings and identifies 1080/1280px sources displayed substantially smaller.
findings.suggestedFix: Create responsive image variants, emit srcset/sizes, prefer AVIF/WebP when possible, and preserve lazy loading with dimensions.

taskList.title: Make the legacy template genuinely responsive
Add security headers and correct cookie policy
Reduce immediate tracking and duplicate analytics
Restore accessible semantics, labels, alt text, focus, and link distinction
Replace custom dropdowns with anchored popovers
Respect system theme and progressively add transitions
